concerns.text: FR-002 reads 'scaffold-based split ([deferred] train, [deferred] validation, [deferred] test)'. The 80/10/10 split is not an unverified empirical value — it is a fixed constant mandated by the source idea ('scaffold-based split (80% train, 10% validation, 10% test)') and by Constitution Principle VI ('MUST enforce a scaffold-based data split (80% train, 10% validation, 10% test)'). The [deferred] marker is sanctioned only for empirical quantities measured at runtime; deferring a constitution-mandated bound under-reaches the idea and risks a plan that violates Principle VI. Restore the explicit 80/10/10 ratios.
